title: The Internet
short: A network that connected the world.
description: The Internet is a global system of interconnected computer networks. It grew from early research networks into the infrastructure behind communication, commerce, science and modern culture.

title: World Wide Web
short: A web of pages linked by hyperlinks.
description: Invented by Tim Berners-Lee at CERN, the World Wide Web made information on the Internet easy to access through browsers, URLs and hyperlinks.

title: Modern Computer
short: A machine that transformed calculation.
description: Modern electronic computers evolved from mathematical theory, wartime engineering and advances in electronics. They became general-purpose tools for science, business and everyday life.

title: Alan Turing
short: A pioneer of theoretical computer science.
description: Alan Turing formalized the idea of a general-purpose computing machine and made foundational contributions to codebreaking and artificial intelligence.

title: Artificial Intelligence
short: Building machines that perform intelligent tasks.
description: Artificial intelligence studies how machines can perform tasks associated with human intelligence, including learning, reasoning, perception and language.

title: Printing Press
short: Knowledge became easier to reproduce.
description: Johannes Gutenberg's movable-type printing system transformed the scale and cost of reproducing texts in Europe, accelerating the circulation of ideas.

title: Electricity
short: The force behind the electric age.
description: The study and practical control of electrical phenomena reshaped industry, communication, lighting and modern technology.

title: Isaac Newton
short: Laws of motion and universal gravitation.
description: Newton's laws of motion and universal gravitation unified the study of motion on Earth and in the heavens, shaping classical physics.

title: Albert Einstein
short: Reimagined space, time and gravity.
description: Einstein's theories of special and general relativity transformed physics and changed how scientists understand space, time, energy and gravity.

title: Evolution
short: How life changes across generations.
description: Evolution by natural selection explains how inherited variation and differential reproductive success shape the diversity of life over generations.

title: DNA Structure
short: The molecular blueprint of life.
description: The double-helix model of DNA revealed a structure capable of storing and copying genetic information, transforming biology and medicine.

title: Moon Landing
short: Humanity's first steps on another world.
description: Apollo 11 landed astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin on the Moon in July 1969, a defining moment in space exploration.

title: Apollo Program
short: A bold engineering journey to the Moon.
description: NASA's Apollo program mobilized scientific, industrial and engineering expertise to land humans on the Moon and return them safely.

title: Renaissance
short: Art, inquiry and ideas flourished.
description: The Renaissance was a period of renewed interest in classical learning, artistic experimentation and human-centered inquiry across Europe.

title: Industrial Revolution
short: Machines transformed work and society.
description: The Industrial Revolution began a shift toward mechanized manufacturing, new energy systems, urbanization and modern industrial economies.

title: Steam Engine
short: A new source of mechanical power.
description: Improvements to the steam engine made reliable mechanical power available for mines, factories, railways and ships.

title: World War II
short: A conflict that reshaped the modern world.
description: World War II was a global conflict that transformed geopolitics, technology, international institutions and societies.

title: Transistor
short: The tiny switch behind modern electronics.
description: The transistor made compact, reliable electronic switching and amplification possible, enabling modern computers and digital devices.

title: Semiconductors
short: Materials at the heart of digital devices.
description: Semiconductor materials can control electrical current, making them essential to transistors, integrated circuits, sensors and processors.

title: Smartphone
short: A computer and camera in your pocket.
description: The modern smartphone combines mobile communication, computing, cameras, sensors and Internet access in a pocket-sized device.

title: Climate Change
short: A changing climate with global consequences.
description: Human-driven climate change is primarily caused by greenhouse gas emissions from energy use, industry, agriculture and land-use change.

title: Charles Darwin
short: Natural selection changed biology.
description: Charles Darwin developed the theory of evolution by natural selection, providing a unifying explanation for the diversity of life.

title: Vaccination
short: Training the immune system to prevent disease.
description: Vaccination uses a biological preparation to stimulate immune protection against infectious diseases, preventing illness and saving lives.

title: Johannes Gutenberg
short: A key figure in European printing history.
description: Gutenberg developed a practical movable-type printing system in Europe, helping make books more widely available.

title: Miguel de Cervantes
short: Author of Don Quixote.
description: Cervantes wrote Don Quixote, a landmark work often considered one of the foundations of the modern novel.

title: TCP/IP
short: The common language of the Internet.
description: TCP/IP is the foundational suite of communication protocols that allows diverse networks and devices to exchange data.

title: Artificial Satellites
short: Orbiting tools for a connected planet.
description: Artificial satellites support communication, navigation, weather forecasting, Earth observation and scientific research.

title: GPS
short: Precise positioning from space.
description: The Global Positioning System uses satellite signals to provide positioning, navigation and timing services around the world.

title: Reformation
short: A movement transformed by printed ideas.
description: The Protestant Reformation reshaped European religious and political life. The printing press helped pamphlets and translations circulate widely.

title: Globalization
short: People, economies and cultures interconnect.
description: Globalization describes the growing connections among countries through trade, technology, migration, culture and communication.

title: Agricultural Revolution
description: The shift from foraging to farming enabled permanent settlements, food surpluses and larger societies.
short: The shift from foraging to farming enabled permanent settlements, food surpluses and larger societies.

title: Writing
description: Writing preserved laws, records, stories and knowledge beyond spoken memory.
short: Writing preserved laws, records, stories and knowledge beyond spoken memory.

title: Mesopotamia
description: Mesopotamian cities developed early systems of administration, writing, trade and monumental architecture.
short: Mesopotamian cities developed early systems of administration, writing, trade and monumental architecture.

title: Ancient Greece
description: The Greek world shaped later traditions in philosophy, mathematics, political thought, drama and scientific inquiry.
short: The Greek world shaped later traditions in philosophy, mathematics, political thought, drama and scientific inquiry.

title: Democracy
description: Democracy grounds political authority in the people and has roots in several ancient societies and many modern forms.
short: Democracy grounds political authority in the people and has roots in several ancient societies and many modern forms.

title: Roman Empire
description: Roman institutions, engineering, law, roads and language influenced societies across Europe, North Africa and western Asia.
short: Roman institutions, engineering, law, roads and language influenced societies across Europe, North Africa and western Asia.

title: Silk Road
description: A network of land and sea routes that moved goods, technologies, beliefs and diseases across Eurasia.
short: A network of land and sea routes that moved goods, technologies, beliefs and diseases across Eurasia.

title: Paper
description: Paper offered a portable and economical surface for recording information, transforming administration, education and publishing.
short: Paper offered a portable and economical surface for recording information, transforming administration, education and publishing.

title: Magnetic Compass
description: The magnetic compass enabled more reliable orientation and became vital for overland and maritime navigation.
short: The magnetic compass enabled more reliable orientation and became vital for overland and maritime navigation.

title: Gunpowder
description: Developed in China, gunpowder changed warfare and later influenced mining, engineering and artillery.
short: Developed in China, gunpowder changed warfare and later influenced mining, engineering and artillery.

title: Nicolaus Copernicus
description: Copernicus proposed a heliocentric model in which Earth and the other planets orbit the Sun.
short: Copernicus proposed a heliocentric model in which Earth and the other planets orbit the Sun.

title: Galileo Galilei
description: Galileo used telescopic observations and experiments to reshape astronomy and the study of motion.
short: Galileo used telescopic observations and experiments to reshape astronomy and the study of motion.

title: Telescope
description: The telescope made distant celestial objects observable in greater detail and transformed astronomy.
short: The telescope made distant celestial objects observable in greater detail and transformed astronomy.

title: Microscope
description: The microscope revealed structures too small to see unaided, opening new paths in biology and medicine.
short: The microscope revealed structures too small to see unaided, opening new paths in biology and medicine.

title: Scientific Method
description: Observation, measurement, hypothesis testing and revision help build reliable explanations of the natural world.
short: Observation, measurement, hypothesis testing and revision help build reliable explanations of the natural world.

title: Michael Faraday
description: Faraday's experiments on electromagnetic induction established principles behind electric generators and transformers.
short: Faraday's experiments on electromagnetic induction established principles behind electric generators and transformers.

title: James Clerk Maxwell
description: Maxwell unified electricity, magnetism and light in equations central to modern physics and communications.
short: Maxwell unified electricity, magnetism and light in equations central to modern physics and communications.

title: Telephone
description: The telephone transmits speech over electrical networks, reshaping personal and business communication.
short: The telephone transmits speech over electrical networks, reshaping personal and business communication.

title: Radio
description: Radio transmits information wirelessly and became central to broadcasting, navigation and communication.
short: Radio transmits information wirelessly and became central to broadcasting, navigation and communication.

title: Airplane
description: Powered flight transformed travel, trade, warfare and how people understand distance.
short: Powered flight transformed travel, trade, warfare and how people understand distance.

title: Germ Theory
description: Germ theory explains that many diseases are caused by microorganisms, transforming hygiene, surgery and public health.
short: Germ theory explains that many diseases are caused by microorganisms, transforming hygiene, surgery and public health.

title: Penicillin
description: Penicillin became the first widely used antibiotic and transformed treatment of bacterial infections.
short: Penicillin became the first widely used antibiotic and transformed treatment of bacterial infections.

title: Smallpox
description: A highly contagious disease that caused immense suffering; vaccination campaigns led to its global eradication in 1980.
short: A highly contagious disease that caused immense suffering; vaccination campaigns led to its global eradication in 1980.

title: Black Death
description: The Black Death devastated populations across Europe, Asia and North Africa and reshaped economies and social life.
short: The Black Death devastated populations across Europe, Asia and North Africa and reshaped economies and social life.

title: Leonardo da Vinci
description: Leonardo combined art, engineering and observation, exemplifying the broad curiosity associated with the Renaissance.
short: Leonardo combined art, engineering and observation, exemplifying the broad curiosity associated with the Renaissance.

title: Algebra
description: Algebra expresses relationships and solves problems using symbols and general rules.
short: Algebra expresses relationships and solves problems using symbols and general rules.

title: Zero
description: Zero as a number and positional placeholder was essential to decimal place value and modern mathematics.
short: Zero as a number and positional placeholder was essential to decimal place value and modern mathematics.

title: Indus Valley Civilisation
description: The Indus Valley Civilisation built planned cities with drainage, standardized weights and extensive South Asian trade.
short: The Indus Valley Civilisation built planned cities with drainage, standardized weights and extensive South Asian trade.

title: Buddhism
description: Buddhism emerged in ancient India and spread across Asia through teaching, travel, translation and trade networks.
short: Buddhism emerged in ancient India and spread across Asia through teaching, travel, translation and trade networks.
